key_facts.interpretation: 405 = Spring-MVC path IS registered. GET not allowed. The /webhooks/{webhookId}/logs path exists in Clockify router. POST is the correct method per TRUTH.yaml.

promotion_evidence: GET on /webhooks/FAKE_ID/logs returned 405 'Request method GET is not supported'. Per probe protocol: 405 = path is registered in Clockify router. This is definitive path-registration evidence. The fake webhook ID did not cause a 'No static resource' response — routing succeeded to the endpoint handler which then rejected the method. Both specs agree on POST. Promoting from UNCONFIRMED-AGREE to LIVE-VERIFIED on 405-confirms-path-registration evidence.
notes: 405 on GET is the gold standard path-registration probe per this project's probe protocol (documented in CLAUDE.md: '404 Spring-MVC No static resource = path absent, 405 = path exists'). Path /webhooks/{webhookId}/logs is registered. POST response shape remains unconfirmed (raw writes blocked). Partial promotion: path existence LIVE-VERIFIED, POST semantics still UNCONFIRMED.
